{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for presence of CONTROL arm
print('CONTROL arm present:', 'control' in df['arm'].str.lower().unique())

# Check for MODERATE severity
print('MODERATE severity present:', 'moderate' in df['severity'].str.lower().unique())

# Check response variable
print('Response variable values:', df['responded'].unique())

# Check if responded is binary
print('Is responded binary?', df['responded'].nunique() == 2)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print('Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:', df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())"}
